turns.reply:
I solved level 1 of task-eb18fcae. I used 90 actions in total, including 1 reset. The human baseline is 78 and the cap is 390, so the cost was a little above baseline.

How the game works:
- You move a 5x5 block. Each move goes 6 cells.
- An 8-colored gate blocks the path to the target. It opens only while a block sits on the 8-colored switch that it connects to.
- Action 5 records your moves so far and puts your block back at the start. A ghost block (color 2) then replays the recorded moves while you move a new block.
- The ghost seems to take one step each time your block actually moves.
- The goal is the U-shaped 9-colored area at the bottom right.

After the reset, the winning moves were `[4,4,4,4,5]`, then `[2]*7 + [4]*5`. That is 17 actions. Most of the other 73 actions went on tests before I understood the ghost.

I saved these rules as a global memory so later instances of this game can use them. The first save call failed because I did not give a title. The second call raised an error only because I used `await` on a normal function. I think the memory was saved, but I did not check.
